scope: Read-only Spring WicketTester plan/scaffold in disposable fixtures; no new graphical/client release matrix, publication, or real application evaluation.

artifact.binaryCompatibility: Compatible. 4 usages of deprecated API. 6 usages of experimental API

manualBindings: example.McpPage.orders: review name injection, field initialization, and the declared type before supplying a test bean.
example.McpPage.factory: review name injection, field initialization, and the declared type before supplying a test bean.
notes: Uses a separate test WebApplication with default Wicket proxy wrapping. Review production routes, sessions, resources, and mock behavior.

Required test dependencies: org.apache.wicket:wicket-tester, org.apache.wicket:wicket-spring, org.springframework:spring-context, jakarta.servlet:jakarta.servlet-api, org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter, org.mockito:mockito-core. Use the project's framework versions and a JUnit Jupiter runner; dependency availability is not checked and build files are not changed.
scopeNotes: Existing deterministic Spring test scaffold, not a runnable-test or runtime-wiring guarantee. Review all TODOs, mock behavior and constructor/application setup.
Source production bean candidates and declared profiles do not select bindings in the isolated test context.
Test-root paths are suggestions from existing writable non-generated Java test roots in the selected module; name collisions and current writability must be checked before any separate file creation.
No build files, sources, roots, inspection settings, sidebar or clipboard are changed. No test, application, Spring context or model is executed.

concurrency.scope: Bounded fixture concurrency check, not an application performance evaluation

codex.configuration: Temporary ephemeral per-process settings in an owned empty directory; normal saved client settings unchanged.

limitations: Static scaffold preparation only. Manual bindings and constructor/application/mock TODOs remain for an agent or developer to review.
Dependency requirements are not dependency-availability findings; no versions or runtime profile bindings are inferred.
Native wire cancellation/session expiry remains unchanged; tool deadline and reconnect apply.
Published preview 1 and its graphical evidence retain the six-tool artifact. New release verification is separate.
No real application accuracy/performance evaluation, test execution by MCP or publication.
